description:
Title: Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna

The robot receives an order.
It asks whether the customer wants a menu or just the burger.
If he wants a menu, the robot starts preparing the drink, which depending on the size can take a variable amount of time.
While doing so, he asks if you want fries or wedges.
If you want fries, he prepares the fries; if you want wedges, he prepares wedges.
Again the duration varies depending on the size fries/wedges order.
After that, he prepares the burger, and gives you enthusiastic status updates every 30 seconds.
Depending on the number of ingredients, the duration for creating the burger varies.
Your order is delivered via a conveyor belt.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_RoboticBurgerSeller" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/robotic-burger-seller">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Order"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoboticBurgerSeller" name="Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderToAsk</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AskMenuOrBurger" name="Ask whether menu or just burger">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderToAsk</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AskToMenuDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MenuDecision" name="Menu or just burger?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AskToMenuDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MenuChosen</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BurgerOnly</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuFork" name="Start menu preparation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MenuChosen</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ForkToDrink</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ForkToSideQuestion</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDrink" name="Prepare drink (duration depends on size)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ForkToDrink</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DrinkToMenuJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AskFriesOrWedges" name="Ask whether fries or wedges">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ForkToSideQuestion</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AskToSideDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideDecision" name="Fries or wedges?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AskToSideDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriesChosen</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WedgesChosen</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFries" name="Prepare fries (duration depends on size)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriesChosen</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriesToSideMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareWedges" name="Prepare wedges (duration depends on size)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WedgesChosen</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WedgesToSideMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideMerge" name="Side prepared">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriesToSideMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WedgesToSideMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SideMergeToMenuJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuJoin" name="Drink and side ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DrinkToMenuJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SideMergeToMenuJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MenuJoinToBurgerMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BurgerMerge" name="Ready for burger preparation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MenuJoinToBurgerMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BurgerOnly</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BurgerMergeToPrepare</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger (duration depends on number of ingredients)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BurgerMergeToPrepare</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrepareToDeliver</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_StatusTimer" name="Every 30 seconds" attachedToRef="Task_PrepareBurger" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TimerToStatus</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_StatusTimer">
        <bpmn:timeCycle xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">R/PT30S</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveStatusUpdate" name="Give enthusiastic status update">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TimerToStatus</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StatusToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StatusGiven" name="Status update given">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StatusToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverConveyor" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrepareToDeliver</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DeliverToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DeliverToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToAsk" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_AskMenuOrBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskToMenuDecision" sourceRef="Task_AskMenuOrBurger" targetRef="Gateway_MenuDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuChosen" name="Menu" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuDecision" targetRef="Gateway_MenuFork">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${orderType == 'menu'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerOnly" name="Just burger" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuDecision" targetRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${orderType == 'burger'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ForkToDrink" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuFork" targetRef="Task_PrepareDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ForkToSideQuestion" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuFork" targetRef="Task_AskFriesOrWedges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DrinkToMenuJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gateway_MenuJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskToSideDecision" sourceRef="Task_AskFriesOrWedges" targetRef="Gateway_SideDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriesChosen" name="Fries" sourceRef="Gateway_SideDecision" targetRef="Task_PrepareFries">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${side == 'fries'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WedgesChosen" name="Wedges" sourceRef="Gateway_SideDecision" targetRef="Task_PrepareWedges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${side == 'wedges'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriesToSideMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFries" targetRef="Gateway_SideMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WedgesToSideMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareWedges" targetRef="Gateway_SideMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideMergeToMenuJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_SideMerge" targetRef="Gateway_MenuJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuJoinToBurgerMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuJoin" targetRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerMergeToPrepare" sourceRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge" targetRef="Task_PrepareBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareToDeliver" sourceRef="Task_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Task_DeliverConveyor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TimerToStatus" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_StatusTimer" targetRef="Task_GiveStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusToEnd" sourceRef="Task_GiveStatusUpdate" targetRef="EndEvent_StatusGiven"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliverToEnd" sourceRef="Task_DeliverConveyor" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderDelivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
